questions.title: Automated File Organizer
questions.description: Create a Java program that scans a folder and organizes files into subfolders by type.
requirements: Categorize: Documents, Images, Videos, Audio, Archives, Others
Create folders if they don't exist
Print a summary of files organized

questions.title: Bulk File Renaming Tool
questions.description: Create a Java application that renames multiple files based on a user-defined naming pattern.

questions.title: Duplicate File Detector
questions.description: Build a program that scans a directory and identifies duplicate files.
requirements: Compare files by size and name (or hash)

questions.title: Automated Data Report Generator
questions.description: Read structured data from CSV/text files, process and generate a summary report.
requirements: Write summary report to a new file

questions.title: Complete Java Automation System
questions.description: Combine file organization, bulk renaming, duplicate detection, data processing and report generation into one menu-driven application.
requirements: Data processing and report generation module with OOP architecture, multithreading, exception handling and logging
